[![VinceChristman](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/3/3b/VinceChristman.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210708004630)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/hotwheels/images/3/3b/VinceChristman.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20210708004630)
**Vincent Christman** is a designer who interned at Hot Wheels from 2011 to 2012. He designed a few trucks from the [Trackin' Trucks](/wiki/Trackin%27_Trucks) line including [Bone Blazers](/wiki/Bone_Blazers) and [Copter Chase](/wiki/Copter_Chase_(Trackin%27_Trucks)). He also designed the [Yellow Ranger - Tiger Zord](/wiki/Yellow_Ranger_-_Tiger_Zord) Character Car. He currently works as an exterior designer for Scout Motors.
